description:
Subscribe to Stables events via webhook. You'll receive POST requests to your URL when events occur.

Event types are dotted and lowercase. Use 'all' to receive everything.

Security: Set a secret to enable HMAC-SHA256 signature verification via X-Webhook-Signature header.

eventTypes.description: Event types to subscribe to (e.g. ['transfer.updated.status_transitioned']), or ['all']

name.description: A descriptive name for this webhook (e.g., 'Transfer status notifications')

secret.description: Optional signing secret for HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification

url.description: The HTTPS URL to receive webhook POST requests

name: create_webhook
title: Create webhook
